purpose: Teach: 下巻/ストローク/ガイダンス/仕手/各論/持ち味/後発/自助

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文集の下巻を執筆しろ
lines.en: Ren — write the second volume of the paper collection.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Clear authority without harshness. Short pause before the task. Expects compliance. Lean forward slightly, eyes on him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表のストロークを練習します
lines.en: Yes. I'll practice the presentation flow.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Quick, almost eager. No hesitation. Small nod on 「はい」. Meeting his eyes — showing he's listening and ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新入生ガイダンスにも参加しろ
lines.en: Ren — you'll also participate in the new student orientation.
lines.style: Same measured tone, same weight. Not a suggestion. Delivered as naturally as the first task. Eyes hold steady contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データの捏造は仕手のような行為だと心得ます
lines.en: Yes. I understand that fabricating research data is an action that betrays a researcher's integrity.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful delivery. Slower than before — he's thinking through the weight of the words. Sincere but slightly stiff with the gravity of it. Almost protective in his precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、総論から各論への展開を意識しろ
lines.en: Ren — be conscious of the transition from general outline to specific arguments.
lines.style: Slight shift in tone — teaching now, not just directing. Still measured. A hint of investment in his development. Eyes sharpen with expectation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の持ち味を出した論文にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the paper showcases our lab's unique strengths.
lines.style: Determined, focused. Faster tempo than the previous response. He's processing the feedback and owning it. Small breath between "Yes" and the rest — absorbing the direction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、後発の研究者でも独自性で勝負しろ
lines.en: Ren — compete on originality, even as a late-career researcher entering the field.
lines.style: This one carries weight. Slower attack. A hand gesture — open palm. Less command, more mentor-wisdom. Eyes soften slightly. He's telling him something Ren needs to hear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者の自助意識を高めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll build stronger self-awareness and initiative among our research team.
lines.style: Final answer — fuller, more confident than before. He's taking the lesson and extending it. Slight lift at the end, like he's committing to something larger. Eyes clear, resolved.
